description: Turns automated emails on or off: `subscribed: false` stops all of them (the same as the unsubscribe link), `subscribed: true` resubscribes, and `kinds` switches individual kinds. Kinds not named keep their setting. Free. Returns the preferences after the change. Needs an API key or a connected account.

digest.description: On the 1st: last month's requests, cache hits and top operations.

feedback.description: Thanks and status changes for feature requests, issues and reviews you filed, upvoted or commented on.

first_boundary.description: One note when you fetch your first boundary.

journey.description: A few short notes in your first month, each with the next step.

milestone.description: When your account passes 100, 1,000, 10,000 or 100,000 requests.

quota.description: When you have used 80% and 100% of this month's plan.

winback.description: A note if your API keys go quiet for a few weeks.

subscribed.description: false = unsubscribe from every automated email; true = resubscribe.
